notes.title: Huge Overhall In-progress
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

As some may know, Forest Liberation was not released on the expected date. This is because
when I was playing through it looking for issues, I came to the conclusion that this did not feel
the way I wanted it to. I was upset by this and took a long break from the project.

I found numerous things I could have done better during some of my tests and decided that I was
going to redo the project. I got rid of many things that didn't prove useful, or even make sense. I have also gave more attention to atmosphere, the environment, dialog and the UI (user interface). 

Some of the many things I have added or changed include:

Added animations to certain objects. (Trees, grass, rocks, etc)
Added a better dialog system.
Added clouds and wind.
Added image effects to enhance atmosphere.
Bullets now have trails.
Objects now cast shadows. (Trees, grass, rocks, etc)
Remade all sprites/textures.
The enemies can now wander around instead of waiting for the player to be near them.
The player now has options as to what they can say to NPCs.
The world used to be generated by noise, but is now hand painted.
Updated engine to Unity 2020.2.0f1.


I am also working on the story of Forest Liberation. Before I redid this project, I felt like it wasn't very engaging. I feel that a story would remove that feeling as well as give it a purpose.

Forest Liberation will be released sometime this year (2021). I don't want to pin an exact date till it's good and ready for others to play. Since I have already missed my initial release date, I want to ensure that when I do release it. That its a good product, and worth the money.

Once I get another large chunk of work done, I will make another announcement. That way those of you who are interested in Forest Liberation know whats going on and when to expect it.

Thanks for reading this, and I hope to make another announcement soon! ~CopingCode
